title: Why China’s DUV Push Hit ASML (ASML) and Micron (MU) for Different Reasons

content_html:
Habib Ur Rehman

Wed, July 29, 2026 at 3:59 AM EDT 3 min read

China has started producing domestic immersion deep-ultraviolet lithography tools, Reuters reported on July 28. State-backed Shanghai Aishengna Electronic Technology Group plans to deliver machines to Semiconductor Manufacturing International, Hua Hong Semiconductor and memory producer ChangXin Memory Technologies. Production is expected to remain small, at roughly five systems in 2026 and about 20 in 2027.

The news struck ASML Holding N.V. (NASDAQ:ASML) through direct product substitution. Export controls already block the company from selling its most advanced extreme-ultraviolet systems into China, leaving DUV scanners as the main lithography category available there. ASML said China generated 29%, or about €9.5 billion, of 2025 net sales; Reuters Breakingviews noted that this revenue was associated with DUV machines and services. A domestic machine that passes production qualification could replace specific future ASML scanner orders and reduce Chinese fabs' dependence on ASML service, even if those fabs still prefer its performance.

"Viable" remains the unresolved word. Reuters reported that the Chinese systems still trail ASML in performance and reliability and require further testing. Chipmakers require overlay accuracy, yield, throughput and uptime in sustained high-volume production. Planned output is also modest beside ASML's installed base. The development raises a strategic risk to future China sales, but it does not show that ASML's tools have been replaced.

Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) is connected through a named competitor and a manufacturing bottleneck. CXMT, one of the intended tool recipients, competes in DRAM. If locally serviceable immersion DUV equipment eventually lets CXMT qualify and add reliable commodity-memory output despite tighter foreign-tool restrictions, the additional bits could pressure industry pricing and Micron's margins. That is a supply-curve risk, not evidence that the new tools can already produce competitive high-bandwidth memory for leading AI accelerators.

Micron's current results push against the most bearish interpretation. For its fiscal third quarter ended May 28, the company reported $41.46 billion of revenue and said data center revenue exceeded $25 billion. Management also said DRAM and NAND demand continued to exceed industry supply. China's DUV progress can influence the future supply curve without invalidating those current conditions.

Insider Monkey reported 154 hedge-fund portfolios with MU long positions at March 31, 2026, up from 137 at December 31, 2025. However, that broadening occurred much before the domestic DUV report.

content_html_zh:
哈比卜·乌尔·拉赫曼

2026 年 7 月 29 日星期三，美国东部时间 3:59 阅读 3 分钟

据路透社 7 月 28 日报道，中国已开始生产国产浸没式深紫外光刻工具。 国家支持的上海艾圣纳电子科技集团计划向中芯国际、华虹半导体和存储器生产商长鑫存储器科技交付机器。 预计产量仍将较小，2026 年产量约为 5 个系统，2027 年产量约为 20 个。

这一消息震惊了 ASML Holding N.V.。 （纳斯达克股票代码：ASML）通过直接产品替代。 出口管制已经阻止该公司向中国销售其最先进的极紫外系统，使得 DUV 扫描仪成为中国的主要光刻类别。 ASML 表示，2025 年中国销售额占净销售额的 29%，即约 95 亿欧元；路透社 Breakingviews 指出，这一收入与 DUV 机器和服务有关。 通过生产资质的国产机器可以取代未来特定的ASML扫描仪订单，并减少中国晶圆厂对ASML服务的依赖，即使这些晶圆厂仍然更喜欢其性能。

“可行”仍然是一个悬而未决的词。 路透社报道称，中国系统在性能和可靠性方面仍落后于 ASML，需要进一步测试。 芯片制造商在持续大批量生产中需要叠加精度、良率、吞吐量和正常运行时间。 除了 ASML 的安装基础之外，计划产量也很有限。 这一发展给未来中国销售带来了战略风险，但这并不表明ASML的工具已经被取代。

美光科技公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）通过指定的竞争对手和制造瓶颈联系在一起。 长鑫存储是目标工具接收者之一，在 DRAM 领域展开竞争。 如果本地可维护的浸入式 DUV 设备最终让 CXMT 获得资格并增加可靠的商品内存输出，尽管外国工具限制更严格，那么额外的位可能会给行业定价和美光的利润带来压力。 这是供应曲线风险，并不能证明新工具已经可以为领先的人工智能加速器生产有竞争力的高带宽内存。

美光目前的业绩与最悲观的解释相反。 截至 5 月 28 日的第三财季，该公司报告收入为 414.6 亿美元，数据中心收入超过 250 亿美元。 管理层还表示，DRAM 和 NAND 需求继续超过行业供应。 中国深紫外技术的进展可以影响未来的供应曲线，而不会使当前的条件失效。

Insider Monkey 报告称，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，有 154 个持有 MU 多头头寸的对冲基金投资组合，高于 2025 年 12 月 31 日的 137 个。 然而，这种扩大早在国内 DUV 报告发布之前就发生了。
